aboutGame.title: What is Dead of Darkness 2?
paragraphs: Dead of Darkness 2 is the sequel to Dead of Darkness (2025), developed and published by Retrofiction Games. The story opens in Pennsylvania, 1985, where Jun Takehara and her old friend Felton are pulled into a nightmare after finding a wounded girl deep in the Appalachian woods.

Rebuilt in a full isometric 2D view, the sequel leans into classic survival horror: scarce ammo, a weight-limited inventory, crafting, puzzles, and seamless switching between up to three characters. Our wiki covers every confirmed system, character, and location in Goldren Creek.

faq.title: Dead of Darkness 2 FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Dead of Darkness 2.

items.question: What is Dead of Darkness 2?
items.answer: Dead of Darkness 2 is an isometric 2D survival horror game from Retrofiction Games. It is the sequel to Dead of Darkness (2025) and follows Jun Takehara and Felton through the mystery of Goldren Creek in Pennsylvania, 1985.

items.question: When does Dead of Darkness 2 release?
items.answer: No release date has been announced yet. Dead of Darkness 2 is currently listed as to be announced on Steam, where you can wishlist it for launch updates.

items.question: What platforms is Dead of Darkness 2 on?
items.answer: Dead of Darkness 2 is confirmed for PC via Steam, with console versions announced for PS5, PS4, Xbox, and Switch 2.

items.question: Can you switch characters in Dead of Darkness 2?
items.answer: Yes. Dead of Darkness 2 lets you switch between up to three characters in certain sections, and the developers use that mechanic for puzzles, sharing gear through a shared item box, and escaping enemies.

items.question: Is there co-op or multiplayer in Dead of Darkness 2?
items.answer: No. Dead of Darkness 2 is a single-player survival horror game, so there is no co-op or multiplayer mode.

items.question: How should beginners start Dead of Darkness 2?
items.answer: Read our Dead of Darkness 2 beginner guide: learn your inventory and combine buttons, keep a light core kit, finish weakened enemies with a knife, and bank one panic medkit for scripted encounters.
